title: Choose a data model from access patterns

questions.question: Why are outcome and checked_at plain columns?
options: SQLite requires every field as a column.
The review queue filters by outcome and sorts by time across all companies.
questions.explanation: Access pattern 3 needs to filter and sort on them, which is simple and fast on plain columns.

questions.question: Which access pattern is awkward for a one-document-per-company design?
options: The latest result for one company
All results waiting for review, oldest first, across companies
questions.explanation: The queue cuts across every company, so a per-company document design has to look inside all documents.

questions.question: Why does review_queue use ? placeholders?
options: Values are passed separately from the SQL, so data cannot change the query.
questions.explanation: Parameter substitution keeps data and SQL apart, which is what the Python sqlite3 documentation recommends.
